summary.prose: Building this Story means swapping one bad constant for a correct one on the vibe side, and adding a small, self-contained TOML-aware gate plus a native capability-discovery call on the codex side. The vibe fix is a single-file, low-risk rename-and-harden. The codex fix layers three independent pieces -- a filesystem walk that decides whether a session can even start, a discovery call that enumerates what's globally registered, and a pure argv builder -- then wires all three into the existing session flow so a codex read-only session either runs with a verified, native tool restriction or refuses clearly before any subprocess work happens.

tasks.title: Fix vibe's read-only tool allowlist and add verifyRuntime's required-tool check
tasks.summary: Add the READ_ONLY_SESSION_VIBE_TOOL_NAMES constant and replace the three independently-hardcoded ['read_file','mcp_insrc_*'] literals at cli-provider.ts:577/670/688-693 with it; add a required-tools-present condition to verifyRuntime alongside its existing unexpected-tool rejection.
acceptanceChecks: READ_ONLY_SESSION_VIBE_TOOL_NAMES is the single source of truth read by all three call sites
verifyRuntime throws when an unexpected tool is reported (existing behavior, unchanged)
verifyRuntime throws when either of the two analyze-tool names is absent from the reported tools, including an empty tools array

tests.name: verifyRuntime throws when an unexpected tool is reported (existing behavior, unchanged)
verifyRuntime throws on an empty tools array or a tools array missing one or both analyze tools
claude: unchanged behavior re-confirmed as a regression guard
vibe: functional proofs unaffected by this round's change

tasks.title: Add a TOML-parsing dependency and walkProjectMcpConfigLayers
tasks.summary: Add a minimal, pure-ESM TOML-parsing dependency (this repo has none today); implement walkProjectMcpConfigLayers(cwd), which resolves the global config's exact file path once and walks cwd to the filesystem root, skipping only the one layer whose own .codex/config.toml path exactly equals that resolved global path, parsing every other layer's config.toml and checking whether its mcp_servers value is non-empty.
acceptanceChecks: walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for the default case (home directory's own config.toml is the global config, declaring mcp_servers.insrc)

walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true when a genuine ancestor layer (CODEX_HOME nested inside the project tree, project root distinct from CODEX_HOME) declares its own mcp_servers table, and false for the same layout with no such declaration
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false when CODEX_HOME lies entirely outside cwd's ancestor chain
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true for each of the four valid TOML forms (dotted header, bare header with dotted/nested keys, inline-table assignment, top-level dotted key-value)
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers propagates a plain Error (not false) on a non-ENOENT read/parse failure at a non-excluded layer

tests.name: walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for a cwd beneath a mocked home directory whose .codex/config.toml (the mocked global config) declares mcp_servers.insrc -- the default-case positive regression test

THE REGRESSION TEST FOR THIS ROUND'S FINDING, using the exact cited layout: mocked CODEX_HOME=/work/repo/codex-state (declaring mcp_servers.insrc), mocked cwd=/work/repo/src, and a mocked /work/repo/.codex/config.toml declaring a mutation-sentinel server -- walkProjectMcpConfigLayers must return TRUE (the sentinel at the project root is still detected and refused) while the SEPARATE case of the same layout with NO sentinel at /work/repo must return false (global insrc remains allowed)

walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false when a mocked CODEX_HOME lies entirely outside cwd's own ancestor chain -- the exclusion comparison never matches, and the walk otherwise behaves exactly as the unbounded design would
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true when a genuine ancestor project layer (distinct from the global config by path) declares its own mcp_servers table, for each of the four valid TOML forms
walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns false for a cwd chain with no non-excluded .codex/config.toml at all

tasks.title: Add discoverCodexMcpServers and replace codexReadOnlySessionArgs
tasks.summary: Implement discoverCodexMcpServers(binPath, cwd, timeoutMs, signal) with the corrected '-C cwd mcp list --json' argv; replace the current 3-argument, unrestricted codexReadOnlySessionArgs with the new 4-argument, pure/synchronous builder that takes the discovered servers list, throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError when insrc is absent, and otherwise emits the existing base argv plus the insrc enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server.
acceptanceChecks: discoverCodexMcpServers' subprocess argv places '-C', cwd before 'mcp', 'list', '--json'
discoverCodexMcpServers propagates a plain Error on non-zero exit, timeout, abort, or unparseable JSON
codexReadOnlySessionArgs, given insrc plus other servers, returns the existing base argv plus the enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server, excluding insrc's own name
codexReadOnlySessionArgs throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError synchronously, with no argv constructed, when insrc is absent from the servers list

tests.name: discoverCodexMcpServers' subprocess invocation places '-C', cwd BEFORE 'mcp', 'list', '--json'
codexReadOnlySessionArgs, given insrc plus two other servers, returns the enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server
codexReadOnlySessionArgs throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError synchronously, with no argv constructed, when insrc is absent from the servers list
codex: the previously-covered misregistration, budget/cancellation, and functional-proof tests, unaffected by this round's exact-path-exclusion fix

tasks.title: Rewire readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch to orchestrate the new checks
tasks.summary: Rewrite readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (cli-provider.ts:604-619) to, in order: call walkProjectMcpConfigLayers(exec.cwd) and throw CodexProjectMcpServersUnexcludableError if true; write the schema temp file as today; call discoverCodexMcpServers(this.binPath, exec.cwd, exec.timeoutMs, exec.signal); recompute the remaining budget and throw ReadOnlySessionTimeoutError if exhausted; call the new codexReadOnlySessionArgs with the discovery result; call runCodex (unmodified) with the recomputed timeoutMs; parse the reply exactly as today.
acceptanceChecks: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexProjectMcpServersUnexcludableError and calls neither discoverCodexMcpServers nor runCodex when walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true
